notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 introduces Steam Cloud Save, fixes critical bugs, and enhances the quality of life of Calcium Chaos: Derailed.

All Changes:
Steam Cloud save:

 Steam Cloud save has been enabled for the main game and the demo!

Game Breaking:

 Fixed issues where Pietra would not continue the fight after you beat her crew

Cutscenes

 Updated cutscenes in Suburbia
 Updated last cutscene in final boss fight

Achievements:

 Fixed some achievements not triggering
 Fixed some achievements triggering when not meant to

Enemies:

 Adjusted elite crab enemies

Quality Of Life:

 Added a better indication of what can be interacted with in the hub
 Shows indicator when the recipe shop has new items
 Sandwich no longer appears when all players have max HP
 Added a visual indicator when the Thaumaturgic Compass activates

Other:

 Made adjustments to different camera positions
 Fixed zoom-in camera not working during some dialogues
 Fixed some sounds playing after players get downed
 Updated Kimberly dialogue sprite
 Fixed issue where players were unable to unlock optional characters after finishing area
 Other small fixes


Special thank you to everyone who reported bugs provided feedback in our Discord Server ✨

notes.title: 🚧 The MEGA Polish Update ✨ (Demo 0.7)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋💀

We've been hard at work brewing something special, and we can't wait to share it with you! 🧪👀

To prepare for that, we have a new beta version ready for testing, and we are looking to expand access to more people! 👷
So, if you're ready to be among the first to test a new, highly polished version of Calcium Chaos: Derailed, be sure to sign up to become a beta tester here: https://forms.gle/eRGfv641XtJq58tx8


That being said, let's get into the Demo changes:
Update 0.7d Highlights:
Warning: Save files from previous versions will be deleted when launching this update.

New Features:
- A new run map where you can decide where to go
- More passive items
- More weapons and weapon combinations
- New encounters

Improvements:
- Weapon combination polish: We've made most combinations more fun and polished
- Economy Rebalanced: We've adjusted the in-game economy for a smoother experience.
- Polished Animations: All characters and enemies have received animation improvements.
- UI Enhancements: See which player is controlling the current menu and dash while standing still for better manoeuvrability.

Fixes:
- Dialogue Issues: Resolved issues where players could get stuck due to dialogues not starting.
- Black Screen Glitches: Fixed occurrences of getting stuck on a black screen.
- Map Animation Bugs: Map dots now animate correctly.
- And Many More Fixes!: Additional bug fixes and optimizations have been implemented to enhance your gameplay experience.

This new demo version brings even more excitement to Calcium Chaos: Derailed, so don't miss out! Be among the first to experience all these updates and provide valuable feedback to help us polish the game to perfection. ✨

notes.title: 🚧 The Localization update (Demo v0.5)🌐💀
notes.notes:
Greetings, Skele-frens! 💀
Since our last update in June for Steam Next Fest, our dedicated team has been tirelessly working on ever more content, and we're on track for the eagerly anticipated full release 🥳

While we are preparing for the full release, we're thrilled to present another significant update to the demo, and as hinted by the title, it's all about localization! 🌎

Now, you can enjoy the game in the following languages:

Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
French
German
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Polish
Brazilian Portuguese
Russian
Spanish

We can't wait for you to explore the land of Calcium Chaos in your preferred language. Stay tuned for more updates as we chug along towards the full release! 💀✨

notes.title: Demo Version 0.4 Ready for NEXT Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello all you Skeletons in Training! 💀
Our development team has been steadily growing as we’re making the next areas. We’re welcoming on board another artist and an animator!
Thanks so much again for all the playthroughs and wishlists! Ahead of Steam Next Fest, we’re overhauling a few systems and adding a few new ones.
Say hello to:

💬 Expanded Dialogue
Amir, Robin and Stanley now have more to say- especially on the train. Take a breather and have a conversation between missions!

🛠️ Updated Combining
A new interface for putting toasters and sodas together! Loot rooms now have workshops that let you tinker to your heart's content,

🗺️ Mission Track
Track your process as you roll across Suburbia, and check out the all-new Side Missions! Complete them to unlock new weapons and stock up on milk!

🎓 Tutorial Rework
The tutorial mission has been made easier- we don’t want anyone to fall off the wagon on the first levels of the game!

👜 Inventory Improved
Players can now throw excess weapons and activatable items in their backpack for later! Combined with the new weapon combining workshop, nothing is left behind!


And other small improvements!
(Also, do be aware that existing save files will be deleted with this update)

notes.title: Demo Version 0.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello Calcium Chaos enjoyers! 💀

We’ve been working to the bone and chugging along behind the scenes, and are now ready to release the v0.3 demo with new features and lots of bug fixes! We've already gotten a lot of great feedback which has helped us a lot so keep it coming! :D

After this update, we’ll be switching tracks to go full steam ahead on the rest of the game. Check in with our Twitter and Discord to see all the sneak peeks! The demo might still change a bit, but the skeleton of it won’t- it’ll keep being pretty bare bones compared to the full release.

Features added

New cutscene
New dialogue
New music track for level complete screen
Vsync option under graphics settings
Lots of new sound effects
Full support for 16:10 aspect ratio
Bone shards get collected automatically when a room is cleared

Bugs fixed

Skeletons sneaking into garages
Getting stuck on the level completion screen
Abilities would stop working if you picked one up that had already been used
Weird behaviours when going to pause menu or back to train while a player has fainted
Being able to pick up a weapon or combine weapons during dialogue
Bone shards not being converted to milk
UI popping up when buying items in Stanley's Shop
And lots more!

notes.title: Development Update 2: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
After months of work the demo is finally out! We've been looking forward to sharing this with you and we're very excited to hear what you think!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245139/bab158bbdf1735c9bcb3bbb4870bb43b9d928b15.png

Content
There's a lot of cool stuff in this demo, here's what to expect:

 Over 1 hour of gameplay!
 Up to 8 unique weapons to unlock!
 Up to 4 players co-op!
 Upgrade your train and make a friend!
 Fight Mr Mox, a general in the necromancers army!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245139/17b730f6ff5f958cc1be30bc4c9e49eef04ac0fe.png

Roadmap
Now that the demo is out, we're chuging along to the next area, the jungle.
Here you'll find overgrown skeletons and deadly traps as well as meet new allies to join you in the fight against Jamba Three Skulls the jungle shaman behind the sudden overgrowth.

Let us know what you think!
Everything in the demo is subject to change as we proceed further with development, and we would love to hear your feedback over on discord to help make Calcium Chaos amazing!
https://discord.gg/sr6BvqUkCF

notes.title: Development Update 1: Demo coming soon!
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first blog update on Steam! We're excited to be introducing new features and give you small teasers of what is to come in the future! 

Demo!
We're currently finishing up a demo, so look forward to that within the next couple of months! 
We've been working on the game since summer 2021, so we're really looking forward to releasing the demo and we hope you will enjoy it!

Weapon Combos 
[previewyoutube=9FGlrtZT3Xg;full][/previewyoutube]
The game will focus heavily on giving players the option to combine weapons doing their playthrough, so we made a video teasing some of the combos you can create!

Updated Loadout UI 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245139/517b0063f0cbfaeffa7a88389d2ccc61049defa9.png

Players will be able to change what weapons they bring on their adventure. We made some changes to the Loadout lockers in the hub, to improve readability and make it easier to navigate.

Minimap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245139/fe02454af4f4ef6b9e2deea5dad1785c11e79741.png

Levels in our game will now have a procedurally generated layout and rooms!! To help the player with navigating the level, we have made a map that will always be available to the player on their journey.

Mission Map/World Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245139/91be19a1f12ee0cf9af462f1a4a018d71f03d7d4.png

From the hub, players can travel to places around the game world and free them from the skeletons! Just go to the world map, pick a location and Robin will drive the train there.

Additional Info
We also have a Discord, where you can chat with the team and read the past updates.
Link Here: https://discord.gg/uwEpwMzp58
